seo.title: Kodiyal Restaurant Sharjah | Authentic Mangalorean Food, Ghee Roast & Fish Thali, Al Nahda
seo.description: Kodiyal Restaurant, Al Wazir building behind KFC, Al Nahda, Sharjah: Mangalorean coastal cuisine with prawns and crab ghee roast, neer dosa, golibaje, fish thali from AED 16 and biryani from AED 14. Breakfast to dinner. 4.8 from 436 reviews.

hero.kicker: Al Wazir Building · Behind KFC · Al Nahda, Sharjah
hero.lede: Authentic Mangalorean coastal cooking: crab and prawn ghee roast, neer dosa, golibaje and Mangalore buns, fish thali and biryani, from breakfast at 7 AM until late.
hero.image_alt: Mangalorean fish thali with papad, curries and rice
